_comment: Exact problem strings emitted by tools/registers_check.py that are known defects in the SOURCE registers (the Drive workbook GP-REG-032-v1.2). They are allowlisted so CI stays green without editing exported data; the export is regenerated from registers/source/ and never hand-edited. Remove an entry once the source is repaired and re-exported. Row numbers are 0-based indexes into the tab's non-empty data rows as tools/registers_import.py emits them. tools/registers_check.py reads EVERY top-level section whose name begins with 'findings'; the sections differ only in which export first made the defect visible and in whether registers/collision_proposal.json covers it. Matching is on the exact string.
_findings_note: The 16 entries under 'findings' were visible in the 2026-09-17 markdown export and are each covered by exactly one record of registers/collision_proposal.json (tools/collision_proposal_check.py enforces that bijection over this section and quotes each colliding row as a byte-exact line of the markdown export).

NOT COVERED BY ANY COLLISION PROPOSAL YET: registers/collision_proposal.json is a dated proposal whose source of record is the 2026-09-17 markdown export, and its checker quotes colliding rows as lines of that export, which has no line for these rows. Per CLAUDE.md rule 8 the proposal is not edited in place; a numbered successor proposal against the xlsx export is required, and tools/collision_proposal_check.py and tests/test_collision_proposal.py (which pin the markdown export and 16 records) must be updated by their owner before it can be checked. Until then these seven defects are allowlisted here, named row by row, and disambiguated nowhere.
